When new evidence lands — a fresh structural defect, a failing verification, an accepted drift, a field-trial finding — trace its blast radius back through GOVERNED_BY to the Decisions that shaped the affected nodes, and surface those decisions as \"this road may be worth re-opening\". Reports the trace and the evidence; never re-opens anything, never ranks the alternatives, never scores a fork (dec:report-dont-judge, dec:alternatives-unranked-forkable). The human decides whether the surprise is large enough to mint a reconsidering Decision (dec:reopen-supersedes). Precedent that the trace works by hand: dec:merge-survivor-provenance carries a \"reconsider\" note found by exactly this path.
